metadata.name: 岐阜駅北口・信長ゆめ広場
metadata.source: PLATEAU 岐阜市 2024年度 CityGML v4
metadata.coordinateSystem: EPSG:6697 source lat/lon/orthometric-height; horizontal EPSG:6675 (JGD2011 Japan Plane Rectangular CS VII); local +X east, +Y source height, -Z north
metadata.verticalDatum: JGD2011 (vertical) height, retained from EPSG:6697; not ellipsoidal height
metadata.license: CC BY 4.0 (PLATEAU policy compatible with PDL 1.0)
metadata.attribution: 岐阜市 3D都市モデル（Project PLATEAU）を加工して作成。地物の切り出し・座標変換・三角形分割：MachiShift。自治体の公式ゲームではありません。
metadata.surveyDateNote: Source resource CSV mixes years and sources by attribute; no single survey date asserted
metadata.accuracy: Independent survey not performed; no centimetre-accuracy claim
metadata.processing: AOI polygon selection; highest available LOD per object; Earcut triangulation incl. holes; position rounded to 1 mm (storage precision, not accuracy)

terrain.modifications: Subset AOI; cut actual LOD3 road/plaza footprint from TIN; interpolate cut edge on each original source triangle plane; no height smoothing
